The server page is simpler. It now has six tabs instead of twelve: **Console**, **Players**, **Content**, **World**, **Files** and **Settings**. Logs and crashes open in a large pop-up from the console, stats sit on the **Players** tab, and backups, the web map, past worlds and world tools are grouped in a side menu on **World**. Old links still work. Each running server's card on the servers overview now shows its tick time, memory and CPU, with a line for the last hour, marked fine, busy or struggling.

The panel is also quicker to get around. Server cards, files, backups and content have **right-click menus** with the same actions as their **⋯** buttons. On a phone, press and hold to get them. Shift and right-click still gives the browser's own menu. **Ctrl+K** (⌘K on a Mac) now finds servers, their tabs and actions, and the panel's pages, as well as help. The **console** suggests commands as you type, including player names, item and block ids, and commands added by mods and plugins. Press **Tab** to fill one in.

Discord chat now posts joins and leaves (they were blank before) and can post deaths and advancements, with a switch for each on the **Discord chat** card. Players move on the web map every second instead of every three, and glide between positions. Installs from before 1.2 that were updated from the panel now get the Caddy setup that serves status pages on server hostnames, so you don't need to re-run the installer. The Rust updater also ships, behind the same off-by-default switch as the Rust agent. Testing notes are in [testing-1.3.0.md](https://github.com/MattA-Official/mc-panel/blob/v1.3.0-beta.3/docs/testing/testing-1.3.0.md).
